name: Smart cross-references (cleveref)
description: `\cref` writes "Figure 1", "Equation (2)", "Section 1" for you, as clickable links.
notes: Load order matters: `xcolor` before `hyperref` (for colour mixes like `blue!60!black`), `hyperref` near the end, `cleveref` **after** it.
`\cref{a,b}` handles lists ("Figures 1 and 2"). Use `\Cref` at the start of a sentence.
Labels: use prefixes like `fig:`, `tab:`, `eq:`, `sec:` so you can tell them apart.
